verdicts.reason: A: the CTA pill crowds the end of 'Sunset' and almost touches it, and runs to the right edge. The logo is shrunk to a tiny fragment jammed onto the start of the tagline line, which trivialises the brand. The cream circle is cropped awkwardly at the left edge. B: the white logo sits on the cream circle at top-left with almost no contrast and is jammed against the top edge. The NEW FLAVOR badge is squashed into a tiny pill you cannot read, and the headline sits partly over the light ellipse. But the headline, tagline and CTA have clean spacing and a clear left-to-right order, so B is the less broken of the two.
